name: worker-test-0f3493dd03/12-future-race-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions: "Start action" and "Wait action" are supported.

Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.runtime includes "sleep", "onGracefulStop", and "StopHandler", but no ballerina/lang.future library is listed.
Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" (list excludes future:cancel).
Statements: supported statement list does not include named worker declarations or worker send/receive actions.
reason: The main assertion races future cancellation against a wait and accepts either 18 or the FutureAlreadyCancelled error. This requires f1.cancel(), a lang.future operation absent from the restricted langlib and method-call lists. Start/wait support alone does not cover cancellation or its asserted error behavior. Named workers and worker messaging throughout the whole file are also not covered by the positive feature lists.
unsupported_constructs: future cancellation via f1.cancel() and the asserted FutureAlreadyCancelled race outcome
named worker declarations and asynchronous/synchronous worker send/receive actions
test_design_notes: The file retains many unrelated worker/message-passing and lock helpers; main specifically executes workerWithFutureTest3.
No @args, @panic, or @output markers are present; main validates the race outcome directly.
runtime:sleep and error:message are explicitly supported; they are not the decisive exclusions.
